problems: Cliopatria's Ryukyu Kingdom row stops at 1520 but the kingdom lasted to 1872 (Domain to 1879): ryukyu-kingdom runs 1429-1879 with new keyframes 1447, 1500 and 1611; the colour agent should expect an identity.end of 1879 for a slug whose Cliopatria row ends 1520.

Cliopatria Nanzan (to 1401) and Chüzan (1402-1428) are wrong: Nanzan stood to 1429 and Chüzan's shapes contain the Nanzan cell; Hokuzan fell in 1416, not 1421/1422. Fixed in the three dossiers (keyframes adjusted or added).

Handover years overlap by design: chuzan ends 1429 and ryukyu-kingdom begins 1429; kenmu-restoration ends 1336 (Feb) and ashikaga-shogunate begins 1336 (Aug); the Cliopatria Kenmu shape runs to 1343 and the Ashikaga row starts 1344, so ashikaga-shogunate_1336 (1336-1343) is a new keyframe on the Kenmu outline.

Validator warns that counterpart 'southern-court' (ashikaga-shogunate) and 'satsuma-domain' (ryukyu-kingdom) have no polity yet; both dossiers need to exist or the events will not resolve. Gazetteer lacks Yoshino, Amami Islands, Yaeyama Islands (resolve warnings: ashikaga 7, kenmu 1, ryukyu 17).
The gazetteer's Okinawa admin1 / 'Ryukyu' region resolves to a bbox reaching 28.37 N, 129.57 E, which is further north than Okinawa Prefecture; the gazetteer agent should check.
One WebFetch guess, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koshamain%27s_revolt, returned URL_NOT_FOUND; the page loaded as https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koshamain and that URL is the one cited.
WebFetch returns a model summary of each page, not raw text; quoted phrases are those the summary marked as quotes, everything else is paraphrased in the notes.
Ledger order in ashikaga-shogunate: the 1336 Kyushu contest_start has no month and so precedes the 11 August 1336 found event.
Capital coordinates (Urasoe, Nakijin, Ōzato, Shuri, Kyoto) are approximate and not from a page. No dossiers existed for any of the six slugs at the start, so none were 'kept from an earlier run'.
